audit.whatIsWrong: Three rows disagreed with the packet chart and with their own prose: Level 6 read Skill though mid says 'the lane tips back toward you'; First item read Riven though whys[5] calls it 'a coin-flip you no longer win cleanly'; 2+ items read Riven though whys[6], spikes[3] and late all give it to Wukong.
audit.why: 48.25% over 2114 games — a losing lane whose chart claimed Riven owned the last two stages.
audit.corrected: Level 6 -> Riven, First item -> Skill, 2+ items -> Wukong, as three matched full/content pairs plus the 2+ items rating.

audit.why: Four spikes present and ordered: Lvl 2-3 W stun, Lvl 6 Blade of the Exile, 1st item Wukong, 2+ items Wukong. Matches the corrected chart.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[4], spikes[1] and wants.you[2] all call Wind Slash an execute. Riven's R text grants AD and range plus one use of Wind Slash, a ranged attack flagged projectile — there is no execute threshold. Separately, Crushing Blow being an auto-attack reset is never stated, so the page tells you to watch for the ability cast rather than the wind-up.
audit.why: The reset is the actual tell for his burst; reacting to the cast is reacting one animation too late.
audit.corrected: Wind Slash: one ranged projectile per Blade of the Exile (R 120/90/60s). Crushing Blow opens his combo as an auto reset — step back on the wind-up.

edits.before: His Q armor-shred starts stacking with every trade, and the clone baits your W off cooldown — neither of you controls the window cleanly.
edits.after: Crushing Blow is an auto-attack reset, so his wind-up is your cue to step back, not the cast — and the clone still baits your W off cooldown.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile's range extension and Wind Slash execute tip the Level 6 all-in back toward you — force the fight or roam before he completes first item.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extra range and your one ranged Wind Slash tip the Level 6 all-in back to you — force it or roam before he finishes first item.

edits.before: Blade of the Exile's extended range and Wind Slash execute let you punish a misplaced Wukong before his clone resets the trade.
edits.after: Blade of the Exile's extended range plus one ranged Wind Slash punish a misplaced Wukong before his clone can reset the trade.

edits.before: Use Wind Slash as an execute on a retreating Wukong, not as a trade-opener he can clone-juke
edits.after: Spend your one Wind Slash on a retreating Wukong, not as a trade-opener he can clone-juke

notes: enemyKit is null in this brief — no Wukong kit file was supplied, so I could verify nothing about Crushing Blow's armour shred, Warrior Trickster's clone duration, or Cyclone beyond the ability names in packet.enemyAbilities (which the text uses correctly). All existing Wukong-side mechanical claims were left untouched; only Riven-side errors and the flagged auto-reset were corrected. Full-layer prose carries mojibake em dashes on disk, so full-layer edits are limited to clean-ASCII enum fields.
